purpose: Create a five-to-eight-minute original interactive browser experience in an independently created desert world where observation and a few meaningful choices alter route, atmosphere, and the final vignette.
targetAudience: Curious desktop and mobile visitors who enjoy concise contemplative interactive stories
narrativeGoal: Let ambiguous environmental signs and accumulated choices create a personal emotional interpretation without recognizable borrowed plot beats.
interactionGoal: Support a small number of legible, meaningful choices that alter route, atmosphere, and the ending without scores or grind.
visualAspirations: Clear silhouettes and readable interaction states
platformConstraints: Keyboard, pointer, touch, and reduced-motion paths
mobileExpectations: Complete experience on a narrow viewport
engineeringConstraints: Keep a smallest playable slice feasible
prohibitedExpressions: Characters from any supplied reference work
Quotes from any supplied reference work
Recognizable plot beats from any supplied reference work
Named fictional locations from any supplied reference work
openQuestions: How explicit should the consequences become before ambiguity is lost?
Which presentation technology best serves the selected concept?
What audio role remains optional and accessible?
